verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs explicitly claim skills auto-trigger based on engineered descriptions ('Claude uses skills when relevant', loads automatically when relevant, skill-creator tool optimizes descriptions 'for better triggering accuracy'), but multiple independent hands-on reports concretely contradict this: developers report skills are 'hit or miss', 'don't use them without being asked', fail to trigger 'even when asked' with proper YAML/semantic triggers, and workarounds (dumping skill content into AGENTS.md instead) are needed to get reliable behavior. missing for 10: consistent reliable auto-triggering confirmed by independent testing, resolution of reported inconsistency.
